definition: rej_rate_with_model_unc: share of replicates (200 replicates x 50 posterior draws) whose simulated diff in NRS change (LDN minus placebo) is below the empirical 5% quantile of the H0 (no-drug) diff distribution at the same n, with model-structure uncertainty (arm-level sigma_rel as fitted) in both distributions; independent seeds | rej_rate_sampling_only: as rej_rate_with_model_unc but with sigma_rel = 0 in both distributions (sampling variability and between-subject variability only) | one-sided, nominal 0.05; under a no-drug hypothesis this is a type-I-error check, under a drug hypothesis it is power
